send_keyframe_to_networking_thread: send a KeyframeAndMessages keyframe to the networking thread via the InterprocessRecord queue
send_client_state_to_main_thread: send a ClientState object to the main thread using the InterprocessRecord client state queue
enable_new_connections: enable or disable new client connections by setting the allow new connections flag on InterprocessRecord
get_queued_keyframes: dequeue all pending keyframes from the InterprocessRecord keyframe queue and return them as a list
get_queued_client_states: dequeue all pending client states from the InterprocessRecord client state queue and return them as a list
